notes.title: German (Deutsche) language available now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

For everyone who wanted other languages available, the German version of Inherit the Earth (Erben der Erde: Die große Suche) is now available free of charge to all existing customers.

It is available in Windows, Mac and Linux (both 32-bit and 64-bit)

Enjoy!
